result.summary: Overall the food delivery app home screen looks well-designed and mostly intact. A few visual issues were found, mainly related to truncated/cut-off content at screen edges and minor layout inconsistencies. No critical breakage detected.

issues.description: The third restaurant card name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated at the right screen edge with no ellipsis, making the name unreadable ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Add text ellipsis/truncation styling to card titles, or ensure horizontal carousel cards show a clear partial-card affordance so users know they can scroll to reveal the full card.

issues.description: An empty, unlabeled category chip is partially visible at the far right of the filter row (after 'Healthy'), appearing as a blank gray pill.
issues.suggestion: This is likely a scrollable chip row, but the cut-off point leaves an ambiguous empty pill. Adjust chip spacing or add an edge fade/gradient to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card (with the '-20%' badge) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name, rating, and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: If this is just the scroll fold, no fix is needed; otherwise ensure adequate bottom padding so the last card's details are not permanently obscured by the tab bar.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the pizza card sits on a dark circular background while the one on the ramen card does not, creating inconsistent icon treatment between cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite-button style (e.g., always add a semi-transparent scrim behind the heart icon) across all cards for visual consistency and contrast.

issues.description: Delivery time badges (e.g., '15-25 min') overlap the food images with white pills; on lighter images like the Green Bowl Poké card, edge contrast between pill and background is low.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle border or shadow to the time badges to ensure they remain distinguishable on light image backgrounds.
